en: A black‑and‑white, vintage postcard photograph showing a large Gothic church with tall pointed-arch windows, heavy stone buttresses and a decorative entrance porch. A baroque-style tower with clock faces and an onion-shaped dome rises above the roof. The foreground shows a cobbled area along the church wall. At the bottom margin of the image there is printed caption text identifying the location.
